requirements.statement: Core assistant, STT, TTS, UI, policy, and media-control functions shall remain usable with all WAN links disconnected.
requirements.verification: Disable USB tether, Wi-Fi uplink, and Ethernet; execute the local voice acceptance sequence.

requirements.statement: Prototype compute shall sustain the configured local AI workload without thermal shutdown or involuntary reboot.
requirements.verification: Run a 60-minute simultaneous STT/LLM/TTS thermal soak while recording clocks, temperature, throttling, and resets.

requirements.statement: A production vehicle unit shall use a production-supported module/carrier implementation rather than a Jetson developer kit.
requirements.verification: Review released BOM and vendor lifecycle classification before installation qualification.

requirements.statement: Primary storage shall be solid-state and sized for OS, local models, rollback image, logs, and offline media without operating near full capacity.
requirements.verification: Verify installed capacity and require at least 20 percent free space at release-image acceptance.

requirements.statement: Prototype storage should use NVMe rather than microSD for sustained model and log workloads.
requirements.verification: Inspect block device topology and run sustained read/write health checks.

requirements.statement: The primary UI shall use a 7 to 10 inch capacitive touchscreen with at least 1280x800 logical resolution.
requirements.verification: Read display EDID/mode and verify touch coordinate mapping at all screen edges.

requirements.statement: The installed panel should provide at least 800 nit rated brightness or equivalent validated daylight readability.
requirements.verification: Review panel specification and perform direct-sun readability evaluation in the installed position.

requirements.statement: The display installation shall not obstruct required controls, driver sightlines, or air-bag deployment zones.
requirements.verification: Vehicle-specific physical installation review before road use.

requirements.statement: Voice capture shall provide a Linux-visible local audio input capable of 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM for the reference STT path.
requirements.verification: Record a WAV using the deployed PipeWire capture command and inspect rate, channel count, and sample format.

requirements.statement: Prototype voice capture should provide acoustic echo cancellation, beamforming, noise suppression, and voice activity detection suitable for cabin testing.
requirements.verification: Run stationary and road-noise voice intelligibility tests with cabin audio playing.

requirements.statement: AXLE audio output shall enter the vehicle audio chain through a line-level or vehicle-specific integration interface, not by direct connection to factory digital buses.
requirements.verification: Inspect wiring and integration-module documentation.

requirements.statement: Loss of AXLE compute power shall not eliminate safety-relevant factory chimes or required factory audio functions.
requirements.verification: Power-loss test with the vehicle-specific audio integration path.

requirements.statement: The audio path should provide enough isolation and grounding control to avoid alternator whine and USB ground-loop noise.
requirements.verification: Measure/listen across engine-off, idle, and charging conditions at low and high audio gain.

requirements.statement: AXLE shall support user-provided USB tethering and Wi-Fi hotspot connectivity without requiring an embedded cellular subscription.
requirements.verification: Connect each supported tether mode independently and verify NetworkManager reports the uplink.

requirements.statement: Loss of WAN shall not prevent local assistant startup or local voice operation.
requirements.verification: Remove active tether during operation and repeat local voice acceptance.

requirements.statement: Vehicle battery power shall pass through an automotive-rated protected conversion stage before reaching AXLE compute or peripheral rails.
requirements.verification: Review power-module qualification evidence and bench-test protected input/output behavior before installation.

requirements.statement: The power subsystem shall provide ignition-state sensing and controlled shutdown or sleep behavior after ignition-off.
requirements.verification: Cycle ignition sense repeatedly and verify clean filesystem shutdown plus restart behavior.

requirements.statement: Prototype vehicle power design shall reserve at least 100 W continuous DC/DC capacity for AXLE compute, display, storage, audio, cooling, and peripherals, excluding the vehicle speaker amplifier.
requirements.verification: Compare measured worst-case draw with converter continuous rating and thermal derating.

requirements.statement: Battery-connected hardware shall include fused protection and a validated low-quiescent-current parked state.
requirements.verification: Inspect fuse placement and measure ignition-off current after the configured sleep/shutdown interval.

requirements.statement: AXLE v1 vehicle telemetry shall be receive-only; the deployed telemetry interface shall have no enabled transmit path.
requirements.verification: Demonstrate application-level no-TX, controller listen-only configuration, and bus-monitor evidence showing zero AXLE-originated frames.

requirements.statement: A production telemetry gateway should enforce transmit inhibition below the AI/UI process boundary, preferably at gateway/controller or physical transceiver level.
requirements.verification: Attempt a transmit operation from an unprivileged and a compromised test process; verify no frame reaches the vehicle bus.

requirements.statement: Provide a dedicated physical voice trigger that can be operated without targeting the touchscreen.
requirements.verification: Road-test hardware-button voice initiation with the display interaction lock active.

requirements.statement: A physical voice trigger shall enter AXLE through a bounded input interface and shall not grant vehicle-control authority.
requirements.verification: Trace the input event to VoiceTrigger.HARDWARE_BUTTON and verify vehicle_write_enabled remains false.

requirements.statement: The browser-facing voice-start interface shall always be classified as a touch trigger and shall not accept caller-asserted wake-word or hardware-button provenance.
requirements.verification: Submit a moving-mode browser request that claims hardware-button provenance and require a locked response with no capture start.

requirements.statement: Compute, storage, wiring, and power conversion shall be mechanically restrained and protected from conductive debris and accidental contact.
requirements.verification: Mechanical inspection of the complete installed assembly.

requirements.statement: The compute enclosure shall maintain stable operation under sustained local inference without repeated thermal throttling that breaks interaction latency.
requirements.verification: Hot-soak inference test with temperature, clocks, throttling flags, and voice-turn latency logged.

requirements.statement: Cooling airflow shall not be blocked by the installed enclosure or adjacent vehicle trim.
requirements.verification: Mechanical airflow inspection plus thermal soak in final mounting orientation.

requirements.statement: NVMe storage, compute module/carrier, microphone, display, and telemetry adapter should remain replaceable without destructive removal of the vehicle harness.
requirements.verification: Perform documented service removal/reinstallation on the prototype harness.

requirements.statement: Production hardware should provide a root-of-trust or secure-boot mechanism suitable for validating the AXLE boot/update chain.
requirements.verification: Review production carrier/module security configuration and execute signed-image rejection test.
